qwen.multilingual_suitability: Candidate model for English-Turkish emotion classification. Suitability will be evaluated on the development set.
qwen.accessibility: Public Hugging Face repository; checkpoint stored locally.
qwen.selection_justification: Primary model for zero-shot prompting, five-shot prompting, and all three PEFT conditions. Selected based on model size, multilingual coverage, instruction-following capabilities, and compatibility with the available hardware.

gemma.multilingual_suitability: Candidate model for English-Turkish prompting comparison. Suitability will be evaluated on the development set.
gemma.accessibility: Gated Hugging Face repository; checkpoint stored locally.
gemma.selection_justification: Secondary model for zero-shot and five-shot prompting only, used to compare prompting performance across two model families.
